moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK No.1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' continues its impressive run, holding the number one spot on the Official UK Singles Chart for an incredible 15th non-consecutive week as of July 23rd.

angles.name: Chart Dominance
angles.copy: 15 weeks and counting! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still reigning supreme at No.1 with 'Rein Me In'. An absolute chart phenomenon! #UKCharts
